scope_boundary: MMIO routing, AW/W independent ordering, response holding, CPU control of Video and NPU, local byte-memory visibility, AXI128 read/write geometry and completion-after-B were exercised.
The independent Video control decoder regression passed 118 checks; wrong target, early W acceptance and wrong read-response routing mutations each exited nonzero with the expected diagnostic.

The main project currently has no production CPU/NPU/Video shared fabric or cache-coherence module; cross-master visibility, CPU fence/cache maintenance against NPU/Video, and physical DDR CDC are therefore still open.
This evidence does not claim PDS timing, board throughput, HDMI electrical timing, or full NPU inference.
